question: Can a cheap deterministic lexical number-absence note for saved numerical warrants use their exact selected source spans with low noise?
authorization: Offline only; no model, source recovery calls, assessment mutation, validator, repair or default change
positive: Baby-OSCAR saved D4 differential warrant from legitimate finalized immutable fork; known count attribution gap, not globally false numbers
control_sampling: Purposeful bounded controls, not random prevalence estimate: 17 existing saved answers in 13 named Code Oct1 cases, quantities independently checked. Whole warrant/unknown/bases kept; numerical correctness alone does not validate risk judgment.

candidate_frozen_before_results.extract: Presentation-normalize whole warrant using existing _normalized_with_spans; bounded regex reuses existing _NUMERIC_ATOM_PATTERN, optional slash ratio, percent suffix. No sentence parsing, clause role inference, arithmetic, rounding or written-number interpretation. Record normalized character positions. Exclude alphanumeric-embedded digits via word boundaries.
candidate_frozen_before_results.test: For each unique extracted expression, strip a percent suffix and use existing _numeric_contains(quote, literal, allow_percent_suffix=True) on each exact selected narrative quote independently. Any selected basis role may supply a factual number. Pool matches across selected citations, never concatenate quotes to create a cross-source literal. Missing literal only, no unsupported or contradiction classification.
candidate_frozen_before_results.annotation_hypothesis: Would show missing expression plus existing exact read_pages actions of the selected spans only, explicitly not evidence of contradiction. No external source or guessed repair action.
candidate_frozen_before_results.threshold: No fixed statistical threshold from this small convenience sample. Reject runtime prototype if common legitimate derived/formatting claims generate material noise, or avoiding noise requires arithmetic/NLP/clause binding absent from current types. Do not retune using case-specific exemptions.
candidate_frozen_before_results.source_types: Compare exact narrative quote or existing stored host_visual transcription, separately tagged. Transcription is host-authored and its literal presence is not verification against pixels. Preserve original image/render identities and existing render_page recovery action; never generate OCR or treat unknown line coordinates as a narrative window.

score: Expression and answer flags; explain every flag on correct numerical controls, inspect detection/misses on Baby, typed-row applicability and basis-role limitations. Report sampling and semantic limits; no labels changed.
next_scientific_issue: Identify a concrete outcome/estimand-sensitive D3 reasoning issue using frozen controls; do not spend remaining work on literal fidelity alone.
